rows.step: calc5 Rule A / one time zone
Precision audit: calc5 already FP8 (not BF16)
Existing-Mac incremental basis: irrelevant to own/API
Median API token prices: unchanged
Fleet eligibility: fixed B300 nodes
Server weight traffic: FP8 27 GB to Q4 15.1875 GB
Align API sample: first 80 synthetic sessions like server
Activity normalization: 2500 calls/day for both paths
Replace synthetic calls with measured calc8 calls
KV geometry: 32768 to r3 34816 B/token
Recurrent state: bf16 78.45 MB to r3 156.89 MB
Count recurrent state in resident occupancy
HBM geometry: replica reserves to r3 pooled free HBM
Add r3 redundant output shadow-prefill (defect)
Daily work window: 8 hours to 10 hours
Peak/headroom: 2 to 1/0.70
R3 sparse team grid (reviewed endpoint)
Integer sweep 1..20000 (grid sensitivity)
Correct all-server output double counting for paper
Paper: retain requested 8-hour operator day
Paper: dense replicas reserve weights/workspace per GPU
Paper: measured KV 34844 B/token

notes: Ordered one-assumption bridge; no claim that the order-independent effects add linearly across integer fleet thresholds.
Legacy already uses FP8, not BF16. Mac purchase basis and unchanged median tariff have no effect on own-cluster/API crossover.
Both finite grids and integer sweeps are bounded above by the supplied maximum; a sparse-grid crossover is not a guarantee at omitted team sizes.
Frozen calc5 outputs remain unchanged. The paper correction removes output shadow-prefill only from all-server demand; hybrid prefill still shadows all generated tokens.

provenance.reason: New analysis settings; 200k memory sizing and 110k rate comparison follow calc3/4; use cap and floor jointly. State read/write counts twice. Calibration scale is a sensitivity multiplier.
